query_analysis.original_query: Our gas-liquid separator is showing inconsistent liquid levels. Could this indicate a control valve issue or demister malfunction? Explain the likely causes and remedies.
query_analysis.expanded_query: Investigate and diagnose the potential causes of inconsistent liquid levels in a gas-liquid separator, considering possible control valve issues and demister malfunctions. Provide explanations of the likely causes and recommend appropriate remedies.

selected_agents.role: Lead root cause investigation of inconsistent liquid levels in the gas-liquid separator
Analyze control valve issues and control system behavior
Evaluate potential demister malfunction and separation process performance

communication_strategy.information_flow: The Troubleshooter coordinates the investigation, integrating inputs from the Dynamics & Control Expert and the Separation Technologist to diagnose the issue
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Collaborative analysis and information sharing to systematically identify likely causes and recommend remedies

clarification_questions: When did the inconsistent liquid levels first occur?
Have there been any recent changes to operating conditions or control setpoints?
Are there any alarms or unusual readings in the control system?
Has maintenance been performed on the control valves and demister recently?
